views.name: cities_by_state_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.state_name AS state_name,
  COUNT(c.city_name) AS city_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.population IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS city_count_with_population,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN c.population IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE AVG(CAST(c.population AS REAL)) END AS avg_city_population,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.population IS NOT NULL THEN c.population ELSE 0 END) AS sum_city_population
FROM state s
LEFT JOIN city c ON c.state_name = s.state_name
GROUP BY s.state_name
views.description: Per-state aggregated city statistics: count of cities, count of cities with non-null population, and average/total population computed over cities with non-null population. Useful for answering questions about average or total city populations by state.

views.name: cities_by_state_ranked
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.city_name AS city_name,
  c.population AS population,
  c.state_name AS state_name,
  -- rank of the city's population within its state (ties preserved)
  (SELECT 1 + COUNT(DISTINCT c2.population)
   FROM city c2
   WHERE c2.state_name = c.state_name
     AND c2.population IS NOT NULL
     AND c2.population > c.population
  ) AS population_rank,
  -- maximum city population within the same state
  (SELECT MAX(c3.population)
   FROM city c3
   WHERE c3.state_name = c.state_name
     AND c3.population IS NOT NULL
  ) AS max_population_in_state
FROM city c
WHERE c.population IS NOT NULL
views.description: Per-state ranking of cities by population (ties preserved) to support top-k/top-1-per-state queries and retrieval of cities with maximal population per state.

  c.state_name AS state_name,

JOIN (

  FROM city
  WHERE state_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY state_name
) sp ON c.state_name = sp.state_name AND c.population = sp.max_population_in_state
WHERE c.state_name IS NOT NULL
